scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: echo "db:migrate is wired in Phase 3 (Prisma). Nothing to migrate yet." && exit 1
scripts.db:seed: echo "db:seed is wired in Phase 3/4 (Prisma). Nothing to seed yet." && exit 1
scripts.db:studio: echo "db:studio is wired in Phase 3 (Prisma). Nothing to open yet." && exit 1
